description: Crypto-vertical GDELT news feed. Deterministic whole-token matching over headline text (title/domain/url only; article text is never read). Tags are COMPUTED by this service, not reported by GDELT. Each article carries computed_tags {assets, topics} (taxonomy crypto-v1) and crypto_native_source. Call gdelt_news_crypto_preflight first to check coverage for free. $0.01 per call — USDC on Solana via x402 (over MCP: call without payment to get the PaymentRequired challenge, then retry with the payment at _meta["x402/payment"]). HTTP equivalent: GET https://exchangerebel.com/toll/news/crypto.

asset.description: Optional taxonomy asset id, e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, DOGE, USDC, USDT, HYPE, TAO, NEAR, SUI, LTC, SEI, AURORA.

topic.description: Optional taxonomy topic id, e.g. etf, regulation, stablecoin, tokenization, treasury, defi, hack-exploit.

name: gdelt_news_crypto
